summary: Journeyman electrician with 10 years of continuous commercial and light-industrial experience, licensed and current on code requirements. Skilled at reading blueprints, running conduit, and testing circuits safely in occupied facilities.

experience.title: Journeyman Electrician
bullets: Read blueprints and prepared wiring sketches to confirm equipment locations and conformance with building and safety codes before rough-in.
Planned and installed conduit, tubing, and junction boxes inside partitions and concealed ceiling spaces, pulling insulated wire to complete circuits between boxes.
Connected wires to circuit breakers, transformers, and panel components, landing feeders up to 400A and verifying torque and terminations.
Used ammeters, test lamps, oscilloscopes, and power tools to assemble, test, and maintain electrical wiring, fixtures, and apparatus across multiple tenant build-outs.
Worked from ladders, scaffolds, and roofs to install and repair lighting, receptacles, and equipment disconnects while maintaining zero lost-time incidents across an average of 40 projects per year.
Maintained a current journeyman electrician license and identification card to satisfy governmental regulations and pass all municipal inspections.

experience.title: Electrician
bullets: Followed blueprints and local code to lay out branch circuits, device boxes, and panel schedules for commercial remodels.
Placed conduit and tubing in designated wall and partition areas and pulled conductors to complete circuits between boxes.
Installed and maintained fixtures, appliances, and motor controls using hand tools and power tools, averaging 95% first-pass inspection approval.
Tested circuits with measuring devices and test lamps to locate faults, then documented repairs and parts used in work orders.

experience.title: Apprentice Electrician
bullets: Assisted journeyman electricians with conduit bending, wire pulling, and mounting of boxes and fixtures on commercial service calls.
Carried and set up ladders and scaffolds, and worked at height to install wiring and equipment under supervision.
Read and interpreted job specifications and blueprints to prepare materials and tools for each day's installation tasks.
Practiced active listening and clear speaking to coordinate with crew leads and building occupants during occupied-space work.

experience.title: Electrical Helper
bullets: Organized tools, conduit, and fittings and delivered them to work areas to support installation and repair tasks.
Observed code-compliant wiring methods and safety procedures while assisting with fixture and receptacle replacements.
Applied basic mathematics to measure runs, cut conduit, and record materials for inventory.
